title: 隧道管片預鑄與養護
summary: 本課聚焦把環片永久受力、製造品質與暫態施工荷載連成完整驗證鏈。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on connect permanent segment behavior, manufacturing quality and temporary construction loads. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「全環與局部荷載」與「材料批次與強度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring and local load cases" and "Material batches and strength": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 全環與局部荷載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring and local load cases: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「全環與局部荷載」如何影響隧道管片預鑄與養護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ring and local load cases” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-segment precasting and curing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預鑄環片完成閉環後承受土水載重，運輸、組裝與推進時卻有不同邊界和集中力。永久環分析不能包辦所有階段，需建立從工廠到受力成環的荷載路徑清單，逐項確認最不利狀態。 假設薄環均勻外壓p=0.3 MPa、半徑3 m，環向膜力N=pR=0.9 MN/m；不含彎矩及接縫。 環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「全環與局部荷載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A closed segmental ring carries ground and water loads, while transport, assembly and thrust impose different restraints and concentrated forces. Permanent-ring analysis cannot cover every stage; trace load paths from factory to completed ring. Assume uniform pressure p=0.3 MPa on a thin ring of radius 3 m; membrane force N=pR=0.9 MN/m, excluding bending and joints. Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ring and local load cases” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「全環與局部荷載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ring and local load cases”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 全環與局部荷載
knowledge.text: 預鑄環片完成閉環後承受土水載重，運輸、組裝與推進時卻有不同邊界和集中力。永久環分析不能包辦所有階段，需建立從工廠到受力成環的荷載路徑清單，逐項確認最不利狀態。
knowledge.textEn: A closed segmental ring carries ground and water loads, while transport, assembly and thrust impose different restraints and concentrated forces. Permanent-ring analysis cannot cover every stage; trace load paths from factory to completed ring.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「全環與局部荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring and local load cases" is correct?
options: 永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。
預鑄環片完成閉環後承受土水載重，運輸、組裝與推進時卻有不同邊界和集中力。
少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。
optionsEn: Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance.
A closed segmental ring carries ground and water loads, while transport, assembly and thrust impose different restraints and concentrated forces.
The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch.
quiz.explanation: 預鑄環片完成閉環後承受土水載重，運輸、組裝與推進時卻有不同邊界和集中力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A closed segmental ring carries ground and water loads, while transport, assembly and thrust impose different restraints and concentrated forces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 全環與局部荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring and local load cases: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「全環與局部荷載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ring and local load cases” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設薄環均勻外壓p=0.3 MPa、半徑3 m，環向膜力N=pR=0.9 MN/m；不含彎矩及接縫。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume uniform pressure p=0.3 MPa on a thin ring of radius 3 m; membrane force N=pR=0.9 MN/m, excluding bending and joints. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設薄環均勻外壓p=0.3 MPa、半徑3 m，環向膜力N=pR=0.9 MN/m；不含彎矩及接縫。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume uniform pressure p=0.3 MPa on a thin ring of radius 3 m; membrane force N=pR=0.9 MN/m, excluding bending and joints.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「全環與局部荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring and local load cases", which statement holds?
options: 同向尺寸偏差可以和獨立隨機誤差一樣平方根加總。
同一環片的吊運支點移動不會改變暫態彎矩。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Same-direction dimensional biases can be combined like independent random errors by root-sum-square.
Moving handling support points cannot change transient bending in the same segment.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 全環與局部荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring and local load cases: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「全環與局部荷載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ring and local load cases” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄全環與局部荷載的資料來源與適用條件。將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for ring and local load cases. List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄全環與局部荷載的資料來源與適用條件。將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for ring and local load cases. List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate.

quiz.question: 要驗證「全環與局部荷載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring and local load cases"?
options: 將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
熱擴散尺度就是實際爆裂深度和必需耐火厚度。
optionsEn: List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Thermal diffusion scale equals actual spalling depth and required fire-protection thickness.
quiz.explanation: 將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 全環與局部荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring and local load cases: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「全環與局部荷載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ring and local load cases” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「全環與局部荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring and local load cases" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。
少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability.
The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch.
quiz.explanation: 環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 材料批次與強度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Material batches and strength: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「材料批次與強度」如何影響隧道管片預鑄與養護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Material batches and strength” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-segment precasting and curing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混凝土強度受配料、含氣、養護和試體代表性影響，單一高強度試塊不代表整批均勻。環片還需控制韌性、密實與尺寸，強度數字只是品質鏈的一部分而非全部驗收證據。 假設三個抗壓試值48、50、52 MPa，平均50 MPa；此小樣本平均不是規範特徵強度。 試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「材料批次與強度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete strength depends on batching, air, curing and specimen representativeness. One high result does not prove a uniform batch, and toughness, compaction and dimensions remain separate parts of segment quality. Assumed compressive results 48,50 and 52 MPa average 50 MPa; this small-sample mean is not a code-defined characteristic strength. Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Material batches and strength” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「材料批次與強度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Material batches and strength”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 材料批次與強度
knowledge.text: 混凝土強度受配料、含氣、養護和試體代表性影響，單一高強度試塊不代表整批均勻。環片還需控制韌性、密實與尺寸，強度數字只是品質鏈的一部分而非全部驗收證據。
knowledge.textEn: Concrete strength depends on batching, air, curing and specimen representativeness. One high result does not prove a uniform batch, and toughness, compaction and dimensions remain separate parts of segment quality.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「材料批次與強度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Material batches and strength" is correct?
options: 少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。
纖維添加重量相同就一定產生相同方向的殘餘拉力。
混凝土強度受配料、含氣、養護和試體代表性影響，單一高強度試塊不代表整批均勻。
optionsEn: The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch.
Equal fibre dosage necessarily produces equal residual tensile resistance in every direction.
Concrete strength depends on batching, air, curing and specimen representativeness.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土強度受配料、含氣、養護和試體代表性影響，單一高強度試塊不代表整批均勻。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Concrete strength depends on batching, air, curing and specimen representativeness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 材料批次與強度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Material batches and strength: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「材料批次與強度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Material batches and strength” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個抗壓試值48、50、52 MPa，平均50 MPa；此小樣本平均不是規範特徵強度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed compressive results 48,50 and 52 MPa average 50 MPa; this small-sample mean is not a code-defined characteristic strength. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對材料批號、拌合與養護紀錄，將試體時間和對應環片連結；依合約試驗方法評估批次分布，異常值須查成因而非直接刪除，製造及品質主管共同確認處置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time; evaluate batch distributions under the contract test method and investigate anomalies rather than deleting them, with joint production and quality review.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個抗壓試值48、50、52 MPa，平均50 MPa；此小樣本平均不是規範特徵強度。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed compressive results 48,50 and 52 MPa average 50 MPa; this small-sample mean is not a code-defined characteristic strength.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「材料批次與強度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Material batches and strength", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

千斤頂總推力除總接觸面積足以排除所有局部劈裂。

High early compressive strength guarantees absence of thermal shrinkage cracking.
Total jack force divided by total contact area excludes all local splitting.

steps.title: 材料批次與強度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Material batches and strength: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「材料批次與強度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Material batches and strength” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對材料批號、拌合與養護紀錄，將試體時間和對應環片連結；依合約試驗方法評估批次分布，異常值須查成因而非直接刪除，製造及品質主管共同確認處置。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time; evaluate batch distributions under the contract test method and investigate anomalies rather than deleting them, with joint production and quality review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄材料批次與強度的資料來源與適用條件。核對材料批號、拌合與養護紀錄，將試體時間和對應環片連結；依合約試驗方法評估批次分布，異常值須查成因而非直接刪除，製造及品質主管共同確認處置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for material batches and strength. Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time; evaluate batch distributions under the contract test method and investigate anomalies rather than deleting them, with joint production and quality review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對材料批號、拌合與養護紀錄，將試體時間和對應環片連結；依合約試驗方法評估批次分布，異常值須查成因而非直接刪除，製造及品質主管共同確認處置。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。
knowledge.textEn: Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time; evaluate batch distributions under the contract test method and investigate anomalies rather than deleting them, with joint production and quality review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄材料批次與強度的資料來源與適用條件。核對材料批號、拌合與養護紀錄，將試體時間和對應環片連結；依合約試驗方法評估批次分布，異常值須查成因而非直接刪除，製造及品質主管共同確認處置。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for material batches and strength. Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time; evaluate batch distributions under the contract test method and investigate anomalies rather than deleting them, with joint production and quality review.

quiz.question: 要驗證「材料批次與強度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Material batches and strength"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對材料批號、拌合與養護紀錄，將試體時間和對應環片連結；依合約試驗方法評估批次分布，異常值須查成因而非直接刪除，製造及品質主管共同確認處置。
完好混凝土擴散係數可以完整代表貫穿裂縫的傳輸。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time.
An intact-concrete diffusion coefficient fully represents transport through a through-crack.
quiz.explanation: 核對材料批號、拌合與養護紀錄，將試體時間和對應環片連結；依合約試驗方法評估批次分布，異常值須查成因而非直接刪除，製造及品質主管共同確認處置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time; evaluate batch distributions under the contract test method and investigate anomalies rather than deleting them, with joint production and quality review. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 材料批次與強度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Material batches and strength: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「材料批次與強度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Material batches and strength” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。
knowledge.textEn: Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「材料批次與強度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

纖維添加重量相同就一定產生相同方向的殘餘拉力。
試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal fibre dosage necessarily produces equal residual tensile resistance in every direction.
Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces.
quiz.explanation: 試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
